questionSnapshot.question: What gift does Isabela have in Encanto?

notes: Read all four answers and relevant full topic digests/category context; checked cross-bank matches, wording, scope, category and editorial difficulty. Did not limit Isabela to roses: plants includes the broader range she discovers. The other powers belong to other named relatives, so their existence in the family does not make them Isabela’s gift.
